player_0.content: New plan: The last attempt was aborted because I included explanatory text and a question ("Do you agree...?") in my first message, violating the rule that non-proposal messages must be direct transmissions without extra commentary or requests for agreement. I must strictly separate negotiation from the formal proposal. My strategy should be: First, send a concise statement of my valuation and a clear, direct offer of a specific partition (e.g., "I take the statue and one whistle; you take the comb and the other whistle") without asking for their opinion. If they accept verbally, we proceed to the secret proposal phase. If not, I will adjust my offer in subsequent messages to be more attractive (e.g., offering the statue and both whistles) while maintaining the strict format of direct statements only. Finally, when ready to finalize, I will use the exact secret proposal format `[Proposal: <number> <object name>, ...]` in a single message without any surrounding text.
